title: 8 Best Multi-Location Social Media Management Tools (2026 Rankings)

facts.quote: SocioConnect generated an additional 15 million organic impressions for the Henderson Wholesale team.

facts.fact: SocioLocal states that tasks which previously took 10+ minutes for 23.5 Degrees (Starbucks franchise) and Caremark now take 2 minutes (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: tasks that previously took 10+ minutes now take just 2 minutes.

facts.quote: Multi-location brands and franchises with 100+ locations looking to turn social media from an expense into a revenue channel.
